subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should OpenClaw approve advancing the per-agent SQLite schema to v12 for ACP parent-stream diagnostics, with the associated upgrade and maintenance obligations?
rationale: Repository policy requires explicit acceptance for SQLite schema-version bumps, and this PR changes persisted agent state rather than only refactoring in-memory behavior.

options.title: Approve v12 with upgrade safeguards
options.body: Record approval, repair the maintenance-path index handling, and require real existing-state upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Avoid the schema advance
options.body: Keep ACP diagnostics out of a new per-agent table and choose an already-approved storage shape instead.

recommendation.title: Approve v12 with upgrade safeguards
recommendation.body: Record approval, repair the maintenance-path index handling, and require real existing-state upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged session/transcript SQLite work is the closest established ownership boundary for per-agent schema and migration decisions.
